fullContent:
Vidaryadi Kashayam 
 Reference: Ashtanga Hridaya Sutrasthana 15/9–10 
 Vidaryadi Kashayam is a very famous classical Ayurvedic medicine in liquid form. This Ayurvedic medicine is very effective to treat the respiratory problems. It also acts as the cardiac tonic. It balances the Vata and Pitta doshas in body. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Vidari – Pueraria tuberosa 
 Erand – Ricinus communis 
 Vrishchikali – Gymnema sylvestre 
 Punarnava – Boerhaavia diffusa 
 Devahva – Cedrus deodara 
 Mashaparni – Teramnus labialis Spreng 
 Mudgaparni – Phaseolus trilobus 
 Kandukari – Mucuna pruriens 
 Abheeru – Crotalaria verrucosa 
 Veera – Roscoea purpurea Royle 
 Jeevaka – Malaxis acuminata 
 Rishabhaka – Manilkara hexandra 
 Dubard – Mimusoops hexandra Roxb. 
 Brihati – Solanum indicum Linn. 
 Prishnaparni – Uraria picta 
 Shalaparni – Desmodium gangeticum 
 Gokshura – Tribulus terrestris 
 Kantakari – Solanum xanthocarpum 
 Shweta Sariva – Cordia wallichii / dichotoma / myxa Linn. / latifolia Roxb. 
 Tripadi – Hamsaraja – Adiantum philippense 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 All the above mentioned ingredients are added with 8 parts of water. It is boiled until reduced to quarter part to make the Vidaryadi kwatha. 
 Dose 
 
 Take 12 – 24 ml, before food, at about 6 – 7am and 6 – 7 pm or as directed by Ayurvedic doctor. 
 It is usually advised to add equal amount of water to the kashayam (decoction). 
 
 Indications 
 
 Myalgia 
 Inflammatory conditions 
 Bronchitis 
 Asthma 
 Cold 
 Cough. 
 Cardiac tonic 
 Very helpful to avoid the complications and speedy recovery after delivery 
 
 Side Effects 
 There are no known side effects with this medicine. However it is advised to take this medicine. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
